summary: SABESP furnished a Form 6-K containing its 3Q26 earnings release, dated November 5, 2026. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium or board recommendation is disclosed. Reported items include 3Q26 core EPS of R$0.31 versus R$0.38 a year earlier, R$4.5bn quarterly capex (+13.8% y/y) and roughly R$12bn for the nine months, adjusted net revenue up 9.0% and adjusted EBITDA up 13.8% y/y, while adjusted net income fell 13.8% on a weaker financial result. A conference call is set for November 6. No risk-arb angle applies as this is a routine periodic earnings filing.
